subaccount_of_cluster.label: Sub-account link with one of his wallets
subaccount_of_cluster.why: A sub-account exists only because its master created it: control declared by the protocol (CLAUDE.md: confirms alone).

agent_of_cluster.label: Agent link with one of his wallets
agent_of_cluster.why: An agent is authorised by the account it trades for: control declared by the protocol.

staking_link.label: Staking link with one of his wallets
staking_link.why: A staking link is declared by both accounts.

shared_agent.label: Shares an authorised agent with him
shared_agent.why: One agent key authorised by two accounts is one operator unless a service shares keys.

direct_transfer.label: Observed transfer with his wallets
direct_transfer.why: 2 of the 412 L1 counterparties (>= $50K) of his three config wallets are his (measured 2026-10-06); OTC desks, market makers and exchanges dominate the rest (rule 8: a transfer is not ownership).

circle_flow.label: Circle transfer with his wallets
circle_flow.why: A Circle transfer named by the protocol on both ends; the direct-transfer base rate. 2 of the 412 L1 counterparties (>= $50K) of his three config wallets are his (measured 2026-10-06); OTC desks, market makers and exchanges dominate the rest (rule 8: a transfer is not ownership).

boundary_transfer.label: Bridge record of money with his world
boundary_transfer.why: A Bridge2/Circle record naming his wallet on one side; the direct-transfer base rate. 2 of the 412 L1 counterparties (>= $50K) of his three config wallets are his (measured 2026-10-06); OTC desks, market makers and exchanges dominate the rest (rule 8: a transfer is not ownership).

two_way_flow.label: Money both ways with him
two_way_flow.why: A relationship: his own wallets have one, and so do OTC desks.

funded_by_target.label: First funding or gas from the target
funded_by_target.why: Gas or first funding of a fresh wallet from his is the shape of funding himself.

boundary_member.label: Holds money that passed through his world
boundary_member.why: Weak: an address holding his money, active on Hyperliquid.

trace_reach.label: His money reached it through quiet hops
trace_reach.why: Reach is evidence, never a vote.

private_deposit_address.label: Paid his private deposit address
private_deposit_address.why: A CEX deposit address belongs to one exchange account (address reuse is the strongest single linkage signal); an OTC payer is the alternative.

boundary_deposit_address.label: Paid his deposit address (protocol record)
boundary_deposit_address.why: The same argument, read from Bridge2 or Circle's own record.

quiet_payee.label: Paid a quiet wallet he also paid
quiet_payee.why: Shared quiet infrastructure; rule 9 already applied upstream.

quiet_first_funder.label: Shares his first funder
quiet_first_funder.why: A first funder measured quiet (rule 9); invalidated if the whole chain later measures it busy.

linkage_graph.label: Shares a deposit address or funder with him
linkage_graph.why: Shared infrastructure in the transfer graph.

amount_correlation.label: His exit re-appeared as its deposit
amount_correlation.why: Every correlation lead so far was a bot or a coincidence, so the band is wide and scales with the correlator's confidence.

dormancy_handoff.label: Born inside a silence of his
dormancy_handoff.why: About 9% of accounts born during his history would land in one of his anomalous windows by chance (7 gaps x 3 days of ~240 days).
dormancy_handoff.band: handoff score s: log10(1+2s) / log10(1+9s) / log10(1+20s)

study_tooling.label: Makes orders the way he does (candidate study)
study_tooling.why: The candidate study's calibrated likelihood ratio (Clopper-Pearson bound, spec 2026-10-06 section 8.3).
study_tooling.band: study LR: log10 LR / log10 LR / log10 LR + 0.3 (for), half log10 LR (against)

execution_program.label: Reproduces his per-coin clip table
execution_program.why: Census-gated match of his SDK slicer; superseded by the study's verdict where it exists (same mechanism).

behavioural_vote.label: Trades like him (validated scorer)
behavioural_vote.why: The behavioural scorer votes only once validated (rule 4).

style_veto.label: Style veto: a different human
style_veto.why: A style veto is a positive finding of a different human.

referral_with_cluster.label: Joined to his wallet by a quiet referral code
referral_with_cluster.why: A code is chosen by whoever types it: an association, quiet codes only.

comovement.label: Trade timing against his
comovement.why: Leads or ties him (same_hand) or follows him (copier): the one timing reading a copier cannot fake.

portfolio_overlap.label: Holds his basket
portfolio_overlap.why: A copier holds the same basket by definition.

graph_reach.label: Reached by the transfer graph
graph_reach.why: Reach without direct flow is not a vote.

operator_group.label: Member of a sub-account family
operator_group.why: Joins cases into one operator cluster.

referral_pair.label: Shares a quiet referral code
referral_pair.why: Related, not merged: an association is not control.

behavioural_score.label: Behavioural score (no vote)
behavioural_score.why: An unvalidated score is history, not evidence.

study_context.label: Candidate study reading
study_context.why: A study verdict that judged nothing (neutral, uncalibrated, insufficient).

model.reading: log10 posterior odds = prior + for each category: strongest family + half of every other family; a family is the max of its supports, the min of its againsts, or the larger in magnitude when both. probability = 1 / (1 + 10^-odds). now = current and standing items at low; central = current/standing at mid plus lapsed at half mid; ceiling = everything not invalidated at high.

calibration.expected_sum: about 0.5 to 3 if the model is calibrated: his unknown wallets in the casebook
